parameters.name: gatewayId
parameters.description: The ID of the cloud-native API gateway.

parameters.name: gatewayType
parameters.description:
The gateway type associated with the HTTP API. Valid values:
- API: cloud-native API gateway.
- AI: AI gateway.

parameters.name: keyword
parameters.description: The search keyword. Supports fuzzy match by API name or exact search by API ID.

parameters.name: pageNumber
parameters.description: The page number, starting from 1. Default value: 1.

parameters.name: pageSize
parameters.description: The page size. Valid range: [1, 100]. Default value: 10.

parameters.name: types
parameters.description:
The type of the HTTP API. You can specify multiple types separated by commas (,). Valid values:
- Http
- Rest
- WebSocket
- HttpIngress

parameters.name: withAPIsPublishedToEnvironment
parameters.description: Specifies whether to return API information that has been published to the specified environment.

parameters.name: withAuthPolicyInEnvironmentId
parameters.description: Specifies the environment ID. The response includes consumer authentication policy information for each API in the specified environment.

parameters.name: withAuthPolicyList
parameters.description: Specifies whether permission authentication policies are enabled.

parameters.name: withConsumerInfoById
parameters.description: Specifies the consumer ID. The response includes the authorization rule list for the specified consumer for each API.

parameters.name: withIngressInfo
parameters.description: Specifies whether to include ingress information.

parameters.name: withPluginAttachmentByPluginId
parameters.description: The plug-in ID. Used to retrieve plug-in publishing information based on this plug-in ID.

parameters.name: withPolicyConfigs
parameters.description: Specifies whether to include policy information.
